issues.reason: The sentence states neither an associated event nor an "-est" dimension for the ranking (the reviewer's own first gap), and `(Ordinal sk_column_1 last column)` says only that the column ranks last among columns — true of the content and well-formed in the Ordinal vocabulary — so the calibration line makes the improvisation acceptable rather than a defect.

gaps_confirmed: An ordinal on a bare NP with no associated event and no "-est" dimension ("Lacy's last column"): the scale slot has no licensed filler.

A temporal possessive NP ("Friday's editions"): the 's genitive yields (Possession <group> friday) and nothing licenses also surfacing the temporal content as a Time / (Weekday friday) term, so "when did it appear?" cannot bind.
new_gaps: Ordinal has no slot for a possessor-restricted domain: "Lacy's last column" ranks the column within Lacy's columns, and that restriction cannot be recorded alongside the rank.
notes: The reduced relative "filed from the hospital" (agentless, Theme/Source), both Possession genitives, and the group witness for the possessed plural all follow the instruction set, and sk_column_1 is correctly reused across the three clauses.
